text: …いや　サカキの　こどもは　かみのけが　あかい　らしいから　おまえ　とは　ちがうか　かんけい　ないなら　ほっとけよ！

structure.jp: サカキの　こどもは　かみのけが　あかい　らしいから
structure.en: since Giovanni's kid apparently has red hair

structure.jp: おまえ　とは　ちがうか
かんけい　ないなら
structure.en: if you have nothing to do with it

patterns.name: 〜らしい
patterns.explanation: らしい says the speaker heard this from someone else and is not sure firsthand. あかい　らしい = 'is red, they say'.

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.span: かんけい　ないなら
patterns.explanation: なら means 'if that is the case'. かんけい　ないなら = 'if you have nothing to do with it'.

patterns.name: 〜ておく
patterns.explanation: ほっとけ is a squeezed spoken form of ほうっておけ: 'leave it as it is', given as a blunt order. ておく here means leaving something in its state. ほっとけ = 'leave me alone'.
